Empowering Women in Tech. Building Future Leaders.

Girls' Computer Programming Club (GCPC) is a student-led platform dedicated to empowering female students in programming, research, innovation, and leadership through semester-based workshops, seminars, and practical activities.

About GCPC

Who We Are

History

GCPC was founded to build an inclusive and high-impact technical ecosystem where female students can grow through practical learning and leadership.

Mission

The mission of the Girls' Computer Programming Club is to engage women in technology by providing education, support, and networking opportunities, aiming to bridge the gender gap in the tech industry and inspire more women to pursue careers in computer programming.

Vision

The vision of the Girls' Computer Programming Club is to create an inclusive and diverse tech community where women are equally represented and empowered to lead and innovate in the technology industry.

GCPC Wings

Structured Wings for Focused Impact

ACM Wing

Build competitive programming strength through structured problem solving, mock contests, and guided algorithm practice for consistent technical growth.

Research Wing

Guide members from idea formation to publication with research methodology, writing support, mentor feedback, and collaborative academic projects.

Career & PR Wing

Prepare members for internships and professional visibility through career readiness, communication practice, branding support, and networking guidance.

Development Wing

Strengthen engineering practice through software projects, modern tooling, systems thinking, and hands-on development experiences.
